verdict.rationale: Sentry has a first-party 'Fingerprint Rules' page under its event-grouping docs, which points to a documented way to customize how events are grouped into issues. The pack shows only the page title and URL, so it gives no detail on default stack-trace grouping or how rules override it. missing for 10: explicit evidence of automatic stack-trace fingerprinting that collapses duplicate events into one issue, detail on how fingerprint rules work (matchers, merging/splitting), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
